mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 8.5% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of months where UNRATE exceeds 8.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) over the past 2 months indicate a broad-based demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth exceeds 1.5% year-over-year, it indicates easing supply constraints that boost corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of months where CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS has increased for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction starts (HOUST) fall below 600,000 units annually, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer wealth and confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where HOUST falls below 600.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 2.0% and 3.0% YoY, respectively, indicate a tightening monetary policy cycle that reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL exceed their respective thresholds.
